panels.title: Error Rate — Errors per Minute (LogQL)
panels.description: Counts ERROR-level log lines from order-service per minute. Spikes during checkout flows indicate saga rollback events, payment failures, or downstream service timeouts.

panels.title: Saga / Event Processing Logs — Payment & Shipment Events (LogQL)
panels.description: Counts order-service log lines related to saga events (payment, shipment, saga) over 5 m. Distinguishes INFO (normal flow) vs WARN/ERROR (rollback or consumer lag) to detect saga fan-out issues.

panels.title: Correlation ID Trace — End-to-End Order Request Chains (LogQL)
panels.description: Streams order-service log lines that carry a correlationId, enabling full-path tracing from order creation through payment initiation to shipment scheduling.

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate — Requests/s per Endpoint (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: http_server_requests_seconds_count | Layer 2 – Label: job=order-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: rate → sum by uri. Shows which order-service endpoints (create, estimate, status) are under the most load during peak checkout hours.

panels.title: HTTP Latency Percentiles — P50 / P95 / P99 (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metric: http_server_requests_seconds_bucket | Layer 2 – Label: job=order-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: histogram_quantile at 0.50, 0.95, 0.99. P99 spikes on POST /api/orders indicate slow saga orchestration or blocking Feign calls to product/user services.

panels.title: RabbitMQ Throughput — Published vs Consumed per Queue (PromQL)
panels.description: Layer 1 – Metrics: rabbitmq_published_total, rabbitmq_consumed_total | Layer 2 – Label: job=order-service | Layer 3 – Range: [5m] | Layer 4 – Function: rate → sum by queue. Consumer lag (published count > consumed count by > 100 on order.payment-initiated) reveals payment-service processing bottleneck.
